the_term: ORDINARY-AT-SIZE: admissible by every floor, unexplained by theorem or artifact, and unremarkable against the size-conditioned base rate of the phenomenon.
why_it_is_needed: THIN-SATURATION asks whether the instrument COULD have spoken. This asks whether what it said was unusual. 'Notable' requires a base rate the same way an excess requires a control.

results.why: 24.5% of freshly drawn regions in this size band read exactly 0. The reading is what typically happens at its size.
